evals.name: author-command
evals.prompt: Model registration in an Authors feature; the editor is not the history owner.
evals.expected_output: Address the produced event to the author.
assertions: Declares a StateChange slice within module and feature.
Declares a typed author identifier on the command.
Maps the name into AuthorRegistered with an explicit for destination.

evals.name: author-view
evals.prompt: Declare a model list for registered authors.
evals.expected_output: One keyed projected model and an observable collection query.
assertions: Maps the displayed name from the event payload.
Declares AllAuthors as an observable collection query.

evals.name: projection-owner
evals.prompt: The author view has a projection and a second builder; the name is assumed to come from the history key. Correct the model.
evals.expected_output: Keep one builder and map identity separately from payload.
assertions: Assigns one builder to the read model.
Uses the history identity only for the key.
Carries and maps the display name explicitly.
